metadata.description: Class 7 Career Discovery Assessment - 60 questions across 8 dimensions

dimensions.name: MI-Inspired Strength Domains
dimensions.scoring: 8 MI domains: Linguistic, Logical-Math, Spatial, Bodily-Kinesthetic, Musical, Interpersonal, Intrapersonal, Naturalistic

dimensions.name: Motivators & Values
dimensions.scoring: 5 motivator types: Achievement, Curiosity, Helping, Independence, Recognition

dimensions.name: Learning Preferences
dimensions.scoring: 4 learning preferences: Visual, Reading, Auditory, Kinesthetic

dimensions.name: Emotional & Social Awareness
dimensions.scoring: Developmental tendencies: Self-Awareness, Empathy, Cooperation, Regulation

dimensions.name: Creativity & Future Readiness
dimensions.scoring: Future-readiness indicators: Exploration, Experimentation, Adaptability, Career Openness

questions.text: Your teacher puts you in a group with students you don't know well. What do you naturally do?
options: Talk when someone speaks to me

questions.text: After spending most of the day with friends, you usually feel…
options: Energised and ready for more interaction
Happy to continue with a few friends

questions.text: When you learn a new topic, what attracts you more?
Your teacher asks you to improve an existing project. You would rather…
Two students disagree about who should get credit for a project. You would first consider…
options: What is fair according to the facts

questions.text: Your friend is struggling with a difficult task. You are more likely to…
options: Show them how to solve it
Ask what kind of help they need

questions.text: You have a large project due in three weeks. You prefer to…
options: Finish it well before the deadline
Start and adjust the plan later
Work on it when I feel ready

questions.text: Your teacher unexpectedly changes the activity you were prepared for. You usually…
options: Want to know the new plan

questions.text: You get an interesting idea during class. You usually…
You are given a free afternoon with no fixed plans. You would rather…
options: Do whatever interests you at the moment

questions.text: Your school gives you a week-long project. Which would you choose?
Which activity sounds most interesting?
Your class receives a mystery to solve. You would enjoy…
options: Creating a story about the mystery

questions.text: Which club would you be most interested in joining?
Which challenge sounds most enjoyable?
options: Find a way to help someone
Persuade others to support an idea

questions.text: Your school wants students to improve the campus. You would rather…
Which role sounds most interesting in a group project?
You get to spend an afternoon exploring one area. You choose…
options: Machines and how things are made

questions.text: Which activity would you enjoy doing regularly?
Imagine you can try a different type of work for one day. Which sounds best?
What number comes next? 4, 8, 12, 16, ___
What comes next? ■ ■ ■ ■ ■ ___
Identify the pattern and select what comes next.
A class has 24 students. They are divided equally into 4 groups. How many students are in each group?
Study this 3�3 matrix carefully. What should replace the question mark?
A cube has a star drawn on its top surface. If the cube is turned upside down, where will the star be?
Which shape completes this rotation pattern?
Which comes next? Seed → Plant → Flower → Fruit → ___
Study the pattern across rows and columns. What belongs in the empty space?
Which activity would you enjoy most?
Which task feels most natural to you?
When you have to explain something, you prefer to…
Which activity attracts you most?
Your teacher gives you an open project. You would like to…
Which would you choose for a free activity?
When you have an idea, you usually like to…
options: Work out whether it makes sense

questions.text: Which statement sounds most like you?
options: I enjoy doing, making or performing.
I enjoy understanding people or the natural world.

questions.text: After completing a difficult project, what would make you happiest?
options: Knowing I did it very well
Knowing I did it my own way

questions.text: Which challenge would motivate you most?
What would make a project exciting?
options: A chance to make a difference
A chance to choose my own approach

questions.text: Which reward would mean the most to you?
When a task becomes difficult, what keeps you going?
Which achievement would make you most proud?
If you could choose your next project, you would want…
options: Freedom to choose what you do

questions.text: Your teacher introduces a difficult topic. You would prefer to…
You want to learn how to use a new tool or app. You would rather…
Before an important test, you prefer to…
You don't understand a new idea. Your first choice is to…
Which classroom activity do you enjoy most?
You receive a lower mark than you expected. What do you usually do first?
options: Think about what I could improve
Take some time to calm down
Try not to think about it

questions.text: You notice a classmate is sitting alone and looks upset. You would…
options: Tell a trusted adult if concerned

questions.text: Your group cannot agree on an idea. You would most likely…
Someone gives you feedback about something you could improve. You…
options: Need some time before acting on it

questions.text: A friend tells you about a problem. You would usually…
options: Encourage them to speak to a trusted adult if needed

questions.text: Your school gives you a problem with no single correct answer. What would you do?
You are given paper, cardboard and other simple materials. What would you prefer to do?
You discover a career you have never heard of. What do you do?
options: Imagine whether you would enjoy it

questions.text: Your first idea for a project doesn't work. What would you do?
options: Start again with a completely different idea

questions.text: When you think about your future, which statement sounds most like you?
options: I already have a few ideas
I want to explore many possibilities
I know the things I enjoy
I am still discovering what suits me
